context_note: Critical on authenticated or sensitive endpoints where caching would expose private data. Public, unauthenticated pages with no sensitive content can safely omit or relax this header.
message: Cache-Control is missing. Sensitive responses may be cached by proxies or browsers.
notes: Disables all caching, which is actively harmful on high-traffic pages with no sensitive data. It is appropriate mainly for authenticated or otherwise sensitive endpoints, not public static content.
remediation: Add: Cache-Control: no-store on authenticated or sensitive endpoints.
